name: High-cardinality group-by
why: Top customers by error volume across 50k distinct customer_id values. This is where a columnar store and an inverted index diverge most, and the dimension vendor benchmarks usually omit.

pulsetrace.unsupported: Same ceiling as the full-scan aggregation: no GROUP BY, so a 50k-cardinality ranking is not expressible against the log API.

query.sql: SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS n FROM bench_logs WHERE level = 'ERROR' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20
